text: Hello, am I speaking with Rahul Sharma? This is the screening assistant calling about the Senior Full-Stack Engineer opening. Is this a good time for a quick five-minute chat?
Haan, yes, this is Rahul. Go ahead, abhi time hai.
Great, thank you. Your resume says you're currently a Senior Software Engineer at Nimbus Tech Pvt Ltd since January 2021. Is that correct?
Yes, that's right. Senior Software Engineer at Nimbus Tech, January 2021 se.
And based on your resume, you have a little over ten years of total experience. Does that sound right?
Actually around 8.5 years full-time. Lumen Digital wala first role was a trainee programme, so I don't count that fully.
Understood, thanks for clarifying. Could you share your current CTC?
Current CTC is 18 LPA, fixed plus variable included.
And what is your expected CTC for this role?
I'm looking at around 24 to 25 LPA.
Noted. What is your notice period?
Officially 60 days hai, but negotiable to 30 days, I've checked with my manager.
That's helpful. May I ask why you're looking for a change?
Mainly growth. Nimbus mein I've done a lot on the platform side, but I want bigger product ownership, end-to-end features own karna chahta hoon.
Makes sense. Which work location would you prefer?
Bengaluru is best since I'm already here, or remote. Both are fine for me.
Thank you. Are you interested in moving forward with this role, and when would you be available for a technical interview?
Yes, definitely interested. Thursday afternoon works, after 2 pm.
Perfect, I'll pass this on to the recruiter and they'll confirm the Thursday slot. Thank you for your time, Rahul. Have a great day!
Thank you, aapka bhi din accha ho. Bye!
